decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The size, massing and rearward projection of the proposed single storey rear extension would be overbearing and visually intrusive and would be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining occupiers. It is thereby contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Revised Extensions Guidelines (2002).

Condition : 2 - The design and position of the rear dormer would be unacceptable and would be detrimental to the appearance of the house and the terrace of houses. It is thereby contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.3.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance on Revised Extensions Guidelines (2002).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and rear roof extension and three rooflights to front elevaion to existing dwellinghouse
